Both DXC panes reject the Sample call. The three notes offered are all about
argument count; the two-argument overload the code is actually asking for is never
listed, and nothing names the type of the first argument. Compare the line just
above it, which assigns the other heap subscript to a local without complaint, and
see the issue thread for the same expression assigned to a SamplerState local or
passed to a user-defined function, both of which compile.
dxc_1_6_2112 is the December 2021 release this was filed against.
